title: Kaleidoscopic Crunchy Uruguayan Pomegranate Salad
description: A citrusy and crunchy Uruguayan salad featuring pomegranate, this dish is perfect for a festive occasion and is friendly to all diets, including Buddhist temple friendly, as it is free from animal products and by-products.

ingredients.name: mixed greens
ingredients.notes: such as arugula, spinach, and lettuce

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, pomegranate seeds, red onion, and orange segments.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and olive oil.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Sprinkle the roasted pumpkin seeds over the top of the salad.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the salad a good toss and adjust the seasoning if necessary.
Serve the salad chilled, garnished with additional pomegranate seeds if desired.
